# Agent runtime references

> Index of /root/.agents/runtime-references for every coding CLI on this host: Muse Code, Claude Code, Codex and Antigravity CLI (agy). Read this index first. Then open only the one reference or official page that the next decision needs. Source: agent-platform `content/runtime-references/`, deployed byte-identical to /root/.agents/runtime-references/. Upstream routes were checked on 2026-11-06 (HTTP 200).

## Local references (on demand)

- [runtime-bootstrap.md](runtime-bootstrap.md): where work, repositories and task state live when a location is missing.
- [codebase-orientation.md](codebase-orientation.md): how to orient in a codebase and workspace without scanning everything.
- [RUNTIME-LOADING.md](RUNTIME-LOADING.md): what each CLI loads at session start and per turn; Hindsight loading versus retention.
- [CLI-LAUNCH.md](CLI-LAUNCH.md): verified launch flags (model, context window, effort, permissions), Herdr tab/agent start, and per-CLI MCP registration, including academy_operations.
- [runtime-wiring.md](runtime-wiring.md): current per-CLI configuration and MCP wiring.
- [global-runtime-routing.md](global-runtime-routing.md): coordination of concurrent writers, shared builds and compact handoffs.
- [HERDR-ORCHESTRATION.md](HERDR-ORCHESTRATION.md): a Lead running several CLIs through Herdr.
- [CONTEXT-GOVERNANCE.md](CONTEXT-GOVERNANCE.md): which store owns which information (task STATE, repository, Hindsight, domain owner); the Academy lesson archive exception.
- [HINDSIGHT-RUNTIME.md](HINDSIGHT-RUNTIME.md): how the Hindsight server stores, retrieves and refreshes pages; write semantics and cost.
- [OFFICIAL-DOCS.md](OFFICIAL-DOCS.md): verified official documentation routes per runtime, with version notes.
- [skills.md](skills.md): the custom skills and where they are owned.
- [runtime-core.v2.md](runtime-core.v2.md): the user-approved shared runtime core text.

## Official upstream indexes (llms.txt)

- [Claude Code](https://code.claude.com/docs/llms.txt): Claude Code docs index. Every page is also available as `.md`. The full text is https://code.claude.com/docs/llms-full.txt (about 10 MB; grep it, do not load it).
- [Anthropic platform](https://docs.claude.com/llms.txt): Claude API and model documentation.
- [Codex](https://learn.chatgpt.com/llms.txt): Codex CLI, configuration and hooks (the same index is at developers.openai.com/codex/llms.txt). Full text: https://learn.chatgpt.com/llms-full.txt (about 2.8 MB).
- [Antigravity](https://antigravity.google/llms.txt): Antigravity and agy. No llms-full.txt (404 on 2026-11-06).
- [Meta Model API and Muse Code](https://dev.meta.ai/llms.txt): Muse Code pages are listed there and can be fetched as `.md`, for example https://dev.meta.ai/docs/muse-code/configuration.md. No llms-full.txt.
- [Herdr](https://herdr.dev/llms.txt): Herdr terminal multiplexer docs; also https://herdr.dev/agent-guide.md.
- [Hindsight](https://hindsight.vectorize.io/llms.txt): Hindsight memory server. Full text: https://hindsight.vectorize.io/llms-full.txt (about 1 MB). The installed API is `GET /openapi.json` on the local server.

## Skills (deployed to /root/.agents/skills)

- herdr, herdr-hermes, explain-precisely, lead-orchestration, lessons-loop, strategy-dialogue: owned by agent-platform `content/skills/`.
- academy-runtime-routing, academy-student-context (with references/lesson-archive.md and references/term-map.md): owned by education-platform `content/skills/`.
- hindsight-coding-agent: vendor-generated by the Hindsight coding-agents installer; do not edit.
